23 Which statement is correct?
A
Gases cannot transmit longitudinal waves.
B
Longitudinal sound waves cannot form stationary waves.
C
Solids can transmit both transverse and longitudinal waves.
D
Transverse waves cannot pass through a vacuum.

hints: Carefully read the question stem and identify the given physical quantities for 9702_s22_11_q23.
Apply the relevant physical formula or conservation principle connecting these quantities.
Calculate or deduce the final result and match with the correct option.
walkthrough: Examine the physical scenario described in the question.
Apply the foundational equations governing this topic to evaluate the options.
The correct deduction leads directly to option C.
